title: The planned full CSP lists connect-src for Supabase only: the reader fetches the preview PDF from the site itself
why_needed: pdf.js 6.3.289 reads /book/khous-preview.pdf with fetch() on the main thread (node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.mjs: PDFFetchStream chosen by isValidFetchUrl, networkStream built in the display layer; the worker has no fetch stream). PLANS/DATA-AND-SECURITY.md:101 specifies connect-src "for the Supabase Data API and /functions/v1" and worker-src self, with no self in connect-src. Shipped as written, the book would fail to open («تعذّر فتح الصفحات.») on every visit; the same directive also governs the static export client-side fetches of the .txt route payloads.
touches: PLANS/DATA-AND-SECURITY.md:101, public/_headers, tests/e2e/security.spec.ts, tests/e2e/reader.spec.ts (run under the full CSP)

title: No test or step covers the reader under touch input on the book itself
why_needed: Every reader e2e uses the mouse or the toolbar; the phone test taps «التالية». Touch on the page goes through page-flip own touch path (250 ms long-press arming, touchend flip), which turns pages on scrolls and double-turns slow taps (READER-02). P10 journeys at 360/768 should include CDP touch on the book: a vertical scroll that starts on it, a 350 ms tap, a swipe.
